title: 第17章 乱流遗骨古宗断壁第18章 核钥染血剑冢门开
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
空间乱流，如同亿万柄无形的刮刀，疯狂撕扯、切割着阴九幽残破的骨架。
每一次冲击，都带来深入骨髓（字面意义）的剧痛。
万魂幡被他死死攥在仅存的骨爪中，魂火微弱如同风中残烛，勉强撑开一层薄如蝉翼的暗金光晕，抵御着最致命的湮灭性能量。
意识在无边的痛苦和混沌的黑暗中沉浮。
胸腹间那道狰狞的“蜈蚣”
伤口在乱流冲击下再次崩裂，粘稠的黑血混杂着丝丝暗金煞气不断渗出、湮灭。
左臂彻底消失，右腿腿骨自膝盖以下粉碎性断裂，仅靠筋腱般的黑气勉强连接。
颅骨布满裂痕，仿佛随时会像瓷器般炸开。
“撑…下去…”
冰冷纯粹的意志在灵魂最深处闪烁，如同暴风雨中不灭的灯塔。
他不能死！
仇敌未灭，神魂未诛！
那断裂的巨剑还未寻到！
不知在狂暴的乱流中沉浮了多久，也许是一瞬，也许是万年。
就在万魂幡的光晕即将彻底熄灭，阴九幽的意识也要被剧痛和黑暗彻底吞噬的刹那——
嗡！
一股截然不同的、带着古老苍凉气息的空间波动，如同温柔的触手，轻轻包裹住了他残破的身躯。
狂暴的乱流撕扯力骤然减弱！
噗通！
阴九幽如同被抛弃的垃圾，重重砸在一片坚硬、冰冷、布满厚厚灰尘的地面上。

巨大的冲击力让他本就濒临崩溃的骨架再次发出令人牙酸的呻吟，多处连接处彻底断开，几乎散架。
他艰难地“睁开”
眼窝。
燃烧的恨焰微弱到了极点，只能勉强视物。
映入“眼帘”
的，是一片无边无际的…废墟。
残垣断壁，高耸入云。
断裂的巨大石柱如同巨神的骸骨，斜插在破碎的大地上。
坍塌的宫殿只剩下基座和零星的飞檐斗拱，上面覆盖着厚厚的、不知沉积了多少万年的灰烬。
空气中弥漫着浓郁的尘埃气息，以及一种…
深入骨髓的、挥之不去的、混合着铁锈和某种腐朽能量的味道。
天空是永恒的昏黄色，没有日月星辰，只有厚厚的、缓慢翻滚的铅灰色尘埃云层，透下微弱的光线。
这里…是哪里？
阴九幽残存的意念扫过四周。
死寂，绝对的死寂。
没有虫鸣，没有风声，只有他自己骨架摩擦的细微声响，在这片浩瀚的废墟中显得如此微不足道。
荒凉、古老、破败…是这里唯一的主题。
content_en:
The turbulent flow of space is like billions of invisible scrapers, tearing and cutting Yin Jiuyou's broken skeleton crazily.
Every impact brought a sharp pain that penetrated into the bone marrow (literally).
The Ten Thousand Soul Banner was tightly grasped by him in the only remaining bone claws. The soul fire was as weak as a candle in the wind, barely holding out a layer of dark gold halo as thin as cicada wings, resisting the most deadly annihilating energy.
Consciousness rises and falls in boundless pain and chaotic darkness.
The ferocious "centipede" between the chest and abdomen
The wound burst open again under the impact of the turbulent flow, and thick black blood mixed with traces of dark gold evil spirit continued to seep out and annihilate.
The left arm completely disappeared, and the right leg bone was shattered from the knee down, barely connected by sinew-like black energy.
The skull was full of cracks, as if it would explode like porcelain at any time.
"Hold on...go on..."
The cold and pure will shines in the deepest part of the soul, like an eternal beacon in the storm.
He can't die!
The enemy has not been destroyed, and the spirit has not yet been killed!
The broken giant sword has not been found yet!
I don’t know how long I have been floating in the violent turbulence. It may be a moment, or it may be ten thousand years.
Just when the halo of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner was about to be completely extinguished, and Yin Jiuyou's consciousness was about to be completely swallowed up by severe pain and darkness——
Buzz!
A completely different space fluctuation with an ancient and desolate atmosphere, like gentle tentacles, gently wrapped his broken body.
The violent tearing force of the turbulent current suddenly weakened!
Plop!
Yin Jiuyou was like discarded garbage, hitting hard, cold, and thickly dusty ground.
The huge impact caused his skeleton, which was already on the verge of collapse, to let out an ear-piercing groan again. Many connections were completely disconnected and almost fell apart.
He "opened" with difficulty
eye sockets.
The burning flame of hatred was so weak that he could barely see.
caught "eyes"
It's an endless... ruins.
The ruins and broken walls tower into the clouds.
The huge broken stone pillars were like the bones of giant gods, thrust diagonally into the broken earth.
Only the base and scattered cornices and brackets were left in the collapsed palace, covered with thick ashes that had accumulated for thousands of years.
The air is filled with a strong smell of dust, and a...
A lingering smell that goes deep into the bones, a mixture of rust and some kind of decaying energy.
The sky is an eternal dim yellow, with no sun, moon or stars, only thick, slowly rolling clouds of lead-gray dust that shine through with weak light.
Where... is this?
Yin Jiuyou's remaining thoughts swept around.
Dead silence, absolute silence.
There was no sound of insects, no sound of wind, only the subtle sound of his own skeleton rubbing together, which seemed so insignificant in this vast ruins.
Desolation, ancientness, dilapidation... are the only themes here.
